name: c4fy
description: Create source-backed C4 context, container, and component diagrams as standalone HTML with a soft rounded UI, animated C1/C2/C3 drill-down, source details, and SVG/JSON export. Use for C4 architecture maps and hierarchical system explanations; not for generic flowcharts, sequence diagrams, or C4 code-level diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: C4 diagrams with soft cards and animated C1/C2/C3 navigation
interface.longDescription: Create source-backed C4 context, container, and component diagrams as standalone HTML with a soft rounded UI, animated C1/C2/C3 drill-down, source details, and SVG/JSON export. Use for C4 architecture maps and hierarchical system explanations; not for generic flowcharts, sequence diagrams, or C4 code-level diagrams.
defaultPrompt: Use $c4fy to create source-backed C4 context, container and component diagrams with smooth animated transitions.
